## Step 2 — labelling agreement
photos labelled: 240, 30 per category segment over 8 segments; labellers: 2; double-labelled overlap: all of them
raw agreement 75.8%; Cohen's kappa (6 labels) 0.459; kappa (harvesting structure or not) 0.392
resolution: no joint session; the protocol's fixed strict rule (positive only if both labellers said storage or recharge). Deviations logged in docs/PHOTO_LABELLING_PROTOCOL.md (labeller A's sheet re-aligned by one row on the coordinator's instruction; key opened before the final sheets)
segment WC: harvesting structure in 5 of 30 photos (strict, 16.7%), 15 of 30 (lenient, 50.0%)
segment WH: harvesting structure in 5 of 30 photos (strict, 16.7%), 14 of 30 (lenient, 46.7%)
so the presence set is MOSTLY NOT harvesting structures: every AUC below is diluted toward 0.5 and is a lower bound on agreement with built structures
